item.title: Momentive Software + Cobalt: Stronger Together for the Road Ahead
item.dc:creator: colleen.bernum@momentivestg.wpenginepowered.com
item.excerpt:encoded: Join us on August 27 at 1:00 pm ET for a comprehensive overview of Momentive Software and what their acquisition of Cobalt means for you — and how they’ll continue to support your success now and in the future.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value:
Welcome, Cobalt Customers — Let’s Shape the Future Together

Join us for an informative webinar to learn what Momentive’s acquisition of Cobalt means for you — and how we’ll continue to support your success.
How this new chapter benefits you:

a:4:{s:6:"item-0";a:1:{s:11:"description";s:199:"Stronger Together in AMS: This acquisition strengthens our shared position in the Association Management Software space — bringing together deep expertise and powerful, integrated solutions.";}s:6:"item-1";a:1:{s:11:"description";s:183:"Purpose-Built for Your Mission: Momentive and Cobalt share a passion for purpose-driven work. Together, we’ll deliver the tools, support, and innovation that help you thrive.";}s:6:"item-2";a:1:{s:11:"description";s:183:"Expanded Support & Innovation: You'll gain access to Momentive’s leading tech and customer success resources—designed to meet your evolving needs and accelerate your goals.";}s:6:"item-3";a:1:{s:11:"description";s:185:"Greater Impact, Powered by You: Our united vision is to help you drive lasting change in your community—by removing barriers, streamlining operations, and empowering your team.";}}

All the training you will ever need
Whether you're onboarding new staff, diving deep into specific modules, or upskilling your technical team, our customizable training programs are designed to meet your needs - your way.
Choose the format that works best for your team:

a:2:{s:6:"item-0";a:2:{s:15:"small_tile_icon";s:16:"box-bx-buildings";s:16:"small_tile_title";s:66:"Classroom-style sessions for collaborative, hands-on learning ";}s:6:"item-1";a:2:{s:15:"small_tile_icon";s:17:"box-bx-user-check";s:16:"small_tile_title";s:62:"One-on-one training for personalized, focused instruction ";}}

Training includes time for client-focused prep and follow-up. This allows the trainer to tailor the agenda to your specific needs, review questions or SOPs provided in advance. We also use the client test environment to create examples and ensure the training will run smoothly and be effective.

You can also select from courses offered in our virtual training catalog with topics including CRM, fundraising, accounting, inventory, membership, certifications, and events. Or let us custom design a course based on your organization’s specific needs.

We are focused on helping you maximize your NetForum software investment. From straightforward services add-ons to customizations or augmenting your staffing needs, no matter your goals we can help you achieve them.

Short on internal technical staff? NetForum Premier Care is for you.

Premier Care is now available to boost your technical support team. Get white glove technical service at a fraction of the cost of in-house staff. Your Premier Care Dedicated Technical Service Rep is there for you and will know your organization and your priorities.
No one knows NetForum like we do
Why choose NetForum Support Services over a consultant?

Solutions tailored to your association’s unique needs

From small and growing organizations to large and established associations, Momentive’s association management solutions scale to meet your unique challenges.
Whether it’s streamlining member management, automating operations, or enhancing engagement, our tools are built to empower your mission.

Where basic auction tools fall short

When you need donor stewardship, clean reporting, and integrations that keep data flowing, “good enough” auction tools can create extra steps—exports, duplicated records, and slower follow-up. GiveSmart keeps event execution and donor data connected so you can move faster.

If you’re comparing GiveSmart and BiddingOwl, start with what your team can’t afford to patch together. GiveSmart brings auctions, ticketing, mobile bidding, and donor stewardship into one connected platform—so you don’t lose time to manual work after checkout.

item.title: GiveSmart vs. MyBooster
item.dc:creator: colleen.bernum@momentivestg.wpenginepowered.com
item.excerpt:encoded: MyBooster supports program-style fundraising. See why teams choose GiveSmart when they need auctions, ticketed events, sponsorships, and donor stewardship—built for event-led fundraising.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Program fundraising vs event fundraising—choose the right tool

Program fundraising and event-led fundraising solve different problems. GiveSmart delivers auction workflows, ticketing, guest management, and donor stewardship—built for high-stakes event nights and repeat giving, not just one campaign window.

MyBooster is designed for program-style school fundraising. If your next phase includes ticketed events, auctions, sponsorship activation, or fund-a-need, a program-only model can limit what you can run. GiveSmart is built for event-led fundraising and long-term donor stewardship.
